power.recovery_criterion: exact (primary): the search confirms a program that contains every planted atom and that is not confirmed on the unplanted residual; any: at least one confirmed program (contaminated when the real residual carries confirmed structure); oracle: the planted program itself passes the confirmation rule. Runs stop early once 'exact' holds.

description: R10 honest-ceiling audit: Darwin-Cage search over NeuroTrajectory out-of-fold residuals with a power analysis (option D)
models: v1 (primary; data/processed/models; nested selection of results/trajectory_cv.json)
pilot_models_note: exploratory pilots in colab/research/fran/_pilot used models_v2; not used here
residual_definition: ensemble mean prediction minus observed level mean (units: vehicle robust SD)
engine: neurotwin.audit.darwin (port of the team lead's Darwin-Cage search; see repo/NOTICE)

alphabet.note: information available at prediction time only; veh_z missing -> 0 in the search view

protocol.confirmation_rule: confirm corr > z/sqrt(n_confirm_rows) AND chemical sign-flip p < P(Z>z), z = 3, 4000 sign flips
